parser_family: tree-sitter-sql (DerekStride grammar, generated parser.c tables and lexer plus scanner.c) on the tree-sitter C runtime; error-tolerant incremental LR parsing with a concrete syntax tree
oracle: The replay rejects trees with ERROR or MISSING nodes and prints the named syntax-tree nodes as JSON; summarize.py reads statement, select_expression, relation, join, where, group_by, order_by, invocation, insert, list, column and literal nodes from it, and run-control requires the hand-written oracle summary.
api: ts_parser_new(); ts_parser_set_language(parser, tree_sitter_sql()); ts_parser_parse_string(parser, NULL, local SQL text, length) -> TSTree (concrete syntax tree; ts_node_has_error false)
coverage: LLVM source coverage of the pinned tree-sitter-sql 0.3.11 grammar (generated parser.c, scanner.c) and the tree-sitter 0.26.11 runtime (lib/src, compiled through lib.c) reached by ts_parser_parse_string
scope: SQL text from local bytes parsed by ts_parser_parse_string with tree_sitter_sql(); valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. The parser is error-tolerant: the replay and probe reject trees that contain ERROR or MISSING nodes. Incremental re-parsing, queries and highlighting are untested.
